list.name: adjudicatario
list.label: Adjudicatário (name or NIPC)
list.description: One or more suppliers (contracts awarded jointly to several selected suppliers are counted once).
list.query: SELECT CASE WHEN entity_id ~ '^[0-9]{9}$' THEN name || ' — ' || entity_id ELSE name END AS __text, entity_id AS __value FROM procurement.entities_adjudicatarios ORDER BY name, entity_id

list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (EUR)
list.description: Minimum absolute contract value in EUR. Contracts with abs(preco_contratual) below this are hidden from every panel. It is applied to the absolute value, so large negative values are kept. It works on top of the fixed EUR 10 rule used at ingest (contracts below EUR 10 are already excluded). Options: 0 (no extra filter), 10, 5000, 20000, 75000. The default is 10.

list.name: show_all_contract_types
list.label: Show all contract types
list.description: Off: contract type is grouped into procedure families (Ajuste direto, Concurso público, Consulta prévia, Other). On: contract type lists every individual tipo_procedimento (20 values). Switching resets the Contract type selection to All when the previous values do not exist in the new list.

list.name: contract_type
list.label: Contract type
list.query: SELECT text AS __text, value AS __value FROM procurement.v_contract_type_options WHERE mode = '${show_all_contract_types}' ORDER BY sort, text
list.description: Procedure family (procedure_family, from contracts.tipo_procedimento); Other = every procedure outside the three named families. Turn on 'Show all contract types' to filter by the exact tipo_procedimento instead.

panels.title: Rows shown

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS rows_shown FROM (SELECT v.idcontrato FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE v.idcontrato IN (SELECT idcontrato FROM procurement.contract_adjudicatarios WHERE entity_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))) AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('__ALL__' = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}]) OR (CASE WHEN '${show_all_contract_types}' = 'on' THEN v.tipo_procedimento ELSE v.procedure_family END) = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}])) LIMIT 5000) t

panels.description: The table below is capped at LIMIT 5000 rows, newest first; this count makes a silent truncation visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.celebrated_at AS "Date", v.adjudicante_name AS "Adjudicante", v.objecto_contrato AS "Objecto", v.preco_contratual AS "Preço", v.preco_total_efetivo AS "Preço efetivo", v.prazo_execucao AS "Prazo (d)", v.valor_por_dia AS "EUR/dia", v.tipo_procedimento AS "Procedimento", v.cpv AS "CPV", v.idcontrato AS "ID" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE v.idcontrato IN (SELECT idcontrato FROM procurement.contract_adjudicatarios WHERE entity_id = ANY(string_to_array('${adjudicatario:csv}', ','))) AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('__ALL__' = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}]) OR (CASE WHEN '${show_all_contract_types}' = 'on' THEN v.tipo_procedimento ELSE v.procedure_family END) = ANY(ARRAY[${contract_type:sqlstring}])) ORDER BY v.celebrated_at DESC LIMIT 5000
